One GitHub Ubuntu24.04 job runs the native production audit first (`node scripts/pre-commit/pnpm-audit-prod.mjs --audit-level=high`), then two independent ordered lint workloads: core stripe1/5 → plugin stripe1/6; plugin stripe6/6 → scripts lint → `pnpm format:check`.
